<!-- pr-reviewer: 05e9367ce73f29c72cb62e887885bc8f5d5691d0 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (with one follow-up recommended, below).

**What looks good**
- One substitution at the job seam (`operation/job.rs`, `carried_stock::judged`): the stock box is the union of declared stock and carried bounds, so every stock-reading law judges at least the real material. The box is a superset of the body: the uncut origin block carried through the turns, intersected with the body bounds from the grid (cell squares plus highest top). An unreadable body falls back to the uncut block, never to air (`carried_stock.rs`, the `Err(e)` arm). The bottom is not read, which is fine for checks judged from above.
- The grid-edge bug fix is correct. `distrust_prior` fires when declared stock exceeds the carried block in XY, which drops both the verify prior and the rest mask, so the raw declared stock judges. It is pinned by `declared_stock_beyond_the_carried_block_is_judged_present`.
- Acquittal only applies through the carried cut path, and `carried_grid(.., through_consumer=false)` correctly excludes the consumer setup's own cuts from the entry body.
- Staleness is covered by reading: a posed op's stamp gains `carried_digest` only when the chain crosses or the carry refuses. That digest is `chain.term` (setups, turns, origin setup stock via `write_setup_stock`) plus the paths ahead, so a setup 1 change restamps the job-stock-grown op. Single-setup, clip-entered and unlinked stamps get `None` and stay byte-identical, and all goldens pass unchanged.
- No unwrap/expect/panic or unsafe casts were added. File sizes are under 400 lines (`across.rs` 272, `job.rs` 362, `stamp.rs` 373). The new module carries a provenance line, the decision file is present, and no deps, build.rs or workflow files are touched.

**Local results** (trial-merged with origin/main: clean, nothing to resolve)
| item | result |
|---|---|
| build | ok |
| app lib | 95 passed |
| carried_verify | 5 |
| rest_across_setups | 5 |
| setup_carry | 5 |
| vertical_rapid_stock | 10 |
| posting | 17 |
| golden_cl | 23 |
| stock_sim_document | 9 |
| setups | 11 |
| operations | 117 (6 ignored) |
| drill_prior | 12 |
| top_stock | 4 |
| remachining | 6 |
| suppressed_rest | 2 |
| setup_relative | 8 |
| setup_align | 9 |
| stock_stamp | 4 |
| clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None blocking.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
1. Gouge-class gap, already named as owed in the decision file: `CARRIED_OUTSIDE_DECLARED` is only a note. Face, 2D pocket and contour ops still machine the declared region. Their lead-ins, entries and side offsets can *feed* into carried material outside the declared stock. The job stock box makes rapids and plunges convict, but a feed approach from "air" into carried material is not a rapid, so no check sees it. I recommend either a blocking warning (or refusal) when a feed move leaves the declared stock into carried material, or at minimum an issue now. #320 is the stated owner; please make sure that issue says so explicitly.
2. Test coverage is thin: one contour fixture. Not pinned: (a) a setup 1 edit restamping a non-rest op in setup 2, which the digest logic supports by reading; (b) single-setup and unlinked stamps being byte-identical (goldens only cover this indirectly); (c) a cylinder or non-box declared stock; (d) the `Ok(None)` and unreadable-body arms. Worth a follow-up.
3. PR #408 (#320) adds `carry::Entry::NewBlock`. #410 has no `match` on `Entry` of its own. Only the existing matches in `rest/across.rs:113-114` and `stock_sim_carry.rs:130-131` need the arm, and `chain_of` must break the chain on `NewBlock` as it does on `Clip`. `carried_block` and `carried_digest` key off `chain.crosses()`, so they follow automatically. Whichever PR merges second needs that arm.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 3ae854b21676c3f260f597d75d5e5e975b76e8a3 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (delta review of 05e9367..3ae854b, trial-merged with current main 692b8fa, which includes #408).

**What looks good**
- Reach test is conservative (carried_stock.rs `engaged_by` / `columns_reach`): the footprint is the chord box grown by the tool radius (a superset of the swept circle); cell spans use floor/ceil, so any partly covered column counts; "beside" is judged on the column's cell edges (centre +/- half cell), so half-cell rounding errs toward refusing; any column above the move's lowest Z counts, so the tool body below the carried top is covered, not just the tip; arcs and helices go through `chords(0.01)` with the min Z of the move; an unreadable grid/NaN top/bad cell size reaches.
- Not bypassable: the note lives in the stamped cache; `program_ops` already refuses Never/Stale ops by name before the gate, `carried_problems` skips suppressed ops like the program does, and all three post paths (single file `post_script_body`, per-op `posting_per_op`, script api) call `verification_report`. Matching uses the `CARRIED_OUTSIDE_DECLARED` prefix constant (`starts_with`), not ad-hoc text.
- No unwrap/expect/panic added; provenance present; no new Warning kind.
- Stock-source pick (#320, per the coordinator's question): honoured by construction. `chain_of` ends the chain at `Entry::NewBlock` ("Its own stock"), so the chain does not cross, `carried_stock_body`/`carried_block` return `None`, and `judged()` returns unchanged: no union box, no overhang, no refusal. An explicit carry ("What X leaves behind") still yields `Entry::Carry` and gets the full treatment. `carried_digest` uses the same `chain_of`, so the stamp follows the pick too.

**Local results (merged with main 692b8fa; merges clean, builds)**
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| app lib | 95 passed |
| carried_verify | 8 passed |
| rest_across_setups | 7 passed |
| setup_carry | 5 passed |
| vertical_rapid_stock | 10 passed |
| posting | 17 passed |
| golden_cl | 23 passed |
| stock_sim_document | 9 passed |
| operations | 117 passed, 6 ignored |
| stock_stamp | 4 passed |
| clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. No test pins "Its own stock" + overhang producing no note/refusal; correct by construction, but a one-liner in carried_verify.rs would lock it against the #320 interplay.
2. The arc bulge between 0.01 mm chords is not added to the footprint; the cell-snapping slack covers it except when a footprint edge sits exactly on a cell boundary (at most 0.01 mm). Negligible.
3. posting.rs is still over ~400 lines (pre-existing, +3 here).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
